title: Trees And Plants 6th Degree Bestowal Differentiation And Adornment And The Opening Of Forms

questions.question: What did the traveler enter after moving through the mountains and plains in his mind?
questions.answer: He entered the world of trees and plants.

questions.question: What big message did the trees and plants seem to say together?
questions.answer: They showed that Allah is One.

questions.question: What three plant parts are named as showing this message?
questions.answer: Leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: In the first truth, what can be seen in each plant and tree?
questions.answer: Kind giving and care can be seen in each one.

questions.question: In the first truth, is that kindness seen only in one plant or in all plants too?
questions.answer: It is seen in all of them too.

questions.question: In the second truth, what do the many different kinds of plants show?
questions.answer: They show wise planning, beauty, and special design.

questions.question: According to the second truth, are plant differences just accidents?
questions.answer: No. They are shown as purposeful.

questions.question: In the third truth, what do many kinds of plants grow from?
questions.answer: They grow from seeds and grains.

questions.question: How are those seeds described before the plants grow from them?
questions.answer: They are simple, small, and very much alike.

questions.question: When plants come out from those similar seeds, how do they appear?
questions.answer: They come out different from one another, with order, balance, and beauty.

questions.question: Does the passage say these plant forms come with mistakes or without mistakes?
questions.answer: It says they come without mistakes.

questions.question: What season is mentioned as bringing many flowers, fruits, and leaves?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: What did the traveler say at the end?
questions.answer: He thanked Allah for the gift of faith.

questions.question: Which living things are the main focus of this passage?
questions.answer: Trees and plants.

questions.question: What was opened for the traveler at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The door to the plant world was opened for him.

questions.question: How did that world seem when he entered it?
questions.answer: It seemed beautiful and full of praise and thanks to Allah.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand from the look of the trees and plants?
questions.answer: He understood that their kinds were showing Allah’s oneness together.

questions.question: What is the first great truth about trees and plants?
questions.answer: They are given blessings and gifts in a clear and caring way.

questions.question: How easy is it to notice that first truth?
questions.answer: It is very easy to see.

questions.question: What is the second great truth about the many kinds of plants?
questions.answer: Their differences and beauty are made with wisdom and mercy.

questions.question: What do these many plant kinds show about their Maker?
questions.answer: They show that their Maker is wise.

questions.question: What is amazing about the seeds in the third truth?
questions.answer: Seeds that look the same can grow into many different plants.

questions.question: How do the plants come out from those seeds?
questions.answer: They come out in an orderly, balanced, and beautiful way.

questions.question: What does the passage say about errors in this growing?
questions.answer: It says there is no mistake in it.

questions.question: Who are the many witnesses to this truth?
questions.answer: The flowers, fruits, and leaves of spring.

questions.question: What feeling filled the traveler at the end?
questions.answer: He felt thankful for belief.

questions.question: Where did the traveler go next in his thoughtful journey?
questions.answer: He went to the realm of trees and vegetables.

questions.question: What did that realm invite him to do?
questions.answer: It invited him to come in and examine it.

questions.question: What kind of gathering did he seem to see there?
questions.answer: He saw a beautiful gathering that showed Allah’s unity and thanked Him.

questions.question: Did the trees and plants act alone or together in their message?
questions.answer: They acted together in one message.

questions.question: What message were they giving?
questions.answer: They were giving the message that only Allah is worthy of worship.

questions.question: Which parts of plants are mentioned as carrying this message?
questions.answer: Their leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What does the first truth teach about gifts in plants?
questions.answer: It teaches that plants are filled with clear blessings and generosity.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show how clear this is in all plants?
questions.answer: It is compared to the brightness of sunlight.

questions.question: What does the second truth say about the many kinds and shapes of plants?
questions.answer: It says they are made on purpose with wisdom, beauty, and mercy.

questions.question: Why does the second truth rule out chance?
questions.answer: Because the differences and decoration are wise and carefully made.

questions.question: In the third truth, how many kinds are spoken about in that great plant world?
questions.answer: It speaks of a huge number of kinds, about a hundred thousand.

questions.question: What starts the growth of these many different plant kinds?
questions.answer: Small seeds and grains start their growth.

questions.question: Even though the seeds are alike, what is special about the plants that come out?
questions.answer: They come out in different forms, full of life and balance.

questions.question: How did the traveler respond after seeing these truths?
questions.answer: He praised Allah for faith.

questions.question: What new gate opened before the traveler?
questions.answer: The gate to the world of trees and plants opened.

questions.question: What was he told to do in that world?
questions.answer: He was told to enter, look, and read its signs.

questions.question: What did he notice right away about that world?
questions.answer: He noticed beauty, order, and signs of worship and thankfulness.

questions.question: What shared belief did the kinds of trees and plants point to?
questions.answer: They pointed to Allah being One.

questions.question: What are the three plant features named in the passage?
questions.answer: The features named are leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: In the first truth, what two ideas are joined with giving?
questions.answer: Careful purpose and generosity are joined with giving.

questions.question: Is this caring generosity shown in just a few plants?
questions.answer: No. It is shown in all of them.

questions.question: In the second truth, what do the differences among plants teach us?
questions.answer: They teach us that plants are made with wisdom and not by accident.

questions.question: What extra beauty is mentioned in the second truth besides difference?
questions.answer: Adornment and special shaping are mentioned.

questions.question: In the third truth, what do very similar seeds produce?
questions.answer: They produce many different kinds of plants.

questions.question: What words describe the way those plants come out?
questions.answer: They come out with order, balance, beauty, and life.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mistakes in this process?
questions.answer: It says there is not even a small mistake.

questions.question: What many things in spring stand as proof of this truth?
questions.answer: The many flowers, fruits, and leaves stand as proof.

questions.question: What blessing did the traveler thank Allah for?
questions.answer: He thanked Allah for the blessing of belief.

questions.question: After the mountains and plains, what did the traveler begin to study?
questions.answer: He began to study trees and plants.

questions.question: How did the plant world call him in?
questions.answer: It called him to come and inspect its world.

questions.question: What did he see had been set up in that world?
questions.answer: He saw a beautiful display showing Allah’s unity and thanking Him.

questions.question: What did all the kinds of trees and plants agree on?
questions.answer: They agreed in showing that Allah is One.

questions.question: Which three things in fruit-bearing plants are spoken of like clear signs?
questions.answer: Their leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What is the main point of the first truth?
questions.answer: Plants show open kindness, giving, and blessing.

questions.question: Does the first truth speak only about single plants?
questions.answer: No. It also speaks about all trees and plants together.

questions.question: What is the main point of the second truth?
questions.answer: Plant variety and beauty are made wisely and on purpose.

questions.question: What does that second truth teach about random chance?
questions.answer: It teaches that random chance cannot explain it.

questions.question: What is the main point of the third truth?
questions.answer: Many different plant forms come from seeds that are alike.

questions.question: What qualities are seen when those plants grow?
questions.answer: Order, balance, beauty, life, and wise purpose are seen.

questions.question: How many mistakes are mentioned in this unfolding of plants?
questions.answer: None are mentioned at all.

questions.question: What are as many as the witnesses to this truth?
questions.answer: They are as many as the flowers, fruits, and leaves in spring.

questions.question: What did the traveler say after understanding this?
questions.answer: He said thanks to Allah for faith.

questions.question: What realm opened to the traveler in this passage?
questions.answer: The realm of trees and plants opened to him.

questions.question: What was he invited to do there?
questions.answer: He was invited to enter and study its signs.

questions.question: What did he learn from the way the trees and plants looked?
questions.answer: He learned that they were all pointing to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How were the species of plants acting together?
questions.answer: They were acting like one united witness.

questions.question: What parts of the plants are named as showing this witness?
questions.answer: Their leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: In the first truth, what shines clearly in plants and trees?
questions.answer: Blessing, generosity, and care shine clearly in them.

questions.question: Is this truth small and hidden, or broad and easy to see?
questions.answer: It is broad and easy to see.

questions.question: In the second truth, what shows the work of a wise Maker?
questions.answer: The many kinds, special forms, and beautiful decoration show it.

questions.question: Why can’t this be explained by chance, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because it is full of purpose, mercy, and wisdom.

questions.question: In the third truth, what do similar seeds and grains become?
questions.answer: They become many different living plants.

questions.question: How do these plants open and grow?
questions.answer: They grow in a measured, balanced, and beautiful way.

questions.question: What else, besides beauty, is seen in their growth?
questions.answer: Life and wise purpose are seen in it.

questions.question: What natural examples are called witnesses for this truth?
questions.answer: The flowers, fruits, and leaves that come in spring.

questions.question: How did this study change the traveler’s heart and words?
questions.answer: It made him praise Allah for the blessing of faith.
